Request an Appointment Today Request an Appointment Why Patients Choose Our Phoenix, AZ (Ahwatukee) Office Welcome to Gentle Dental Ahwatukee, where your dental well-being is our top priority. We pride ourselves on creating connections with our valued patients, ensuring an exceptional experience while providing top-tier dental care and guidance for your overall health. Our highly skilled team of dentists specializes in delivering gentle, empathetic, and individualized family dentistry services that cater to patients of all age groups, including children and teenagers. Harnessing the power of cutting-edge technologies and the latest advancements, we offer an extensive array of dental services, encompassing general dentistry, orthodontics, cosmetic enhancements, dental implants, periodontics, endodontics, oral surgery, teeth brightening, and more. Recognizing the significance of a radiant smile, we offer comprehensive cosmetic dental solutions. This includes highly effective teeth whitening treatments and exceptionally lifelike veneers, along with both traditional orthodontics and Invisalign clear aligners to perfect your smile. We make it easier to prioritize your dental care with convenient scheduling options and flexible appointment availability. Our location, conveniently situated just West of I-10, Northwest of the 202 interchange on Chandler Blvd, near Carls Jr., boasts ample parking, including accessible spaces for your convenience. Affordability is key, and we accept most insurance plans. For those without insurance, our Gentle Dental Smile Plan provides access to cost-effective preventive and diagnostic care, with substantial discounts of 20% or more on all dental treatments. Additionally, we offer flexible payment plans to suit your needs. Join us at our welcoming address, 4910 E Chandler Blvd, Suite 120, Phoenix, AZ 85048. To book an appointment or seek further assistance, please connect with our friendly team. We’re here to serve you with a smile. Find us on the map Photos and videos Complete Dental Care for Your Entire Family Our Phoenix dental office provides customized dental care solutions for every patient and every occasion. Whether you need routine preventive care, emergency services, orthodontic treatment, cosmetic enhancements, or pediatric dentistry for your children, Gentle Dental Ahwatukee has flexible care options to accommodate your unique needs and goals for a healthy, beautiful smile. Gail Downs D.D.S., General Dentist View bio Bradford Kess D.D.S, M.A., M.S., Orthodontist View bio Gail Downs D.D.S., General Dentist Dr. Gail J. Downs is a dedicated general dentist committed to delivering high-quality, patient-centered care. She provides a wide range of services including restorative dentistry, prosthodontics, and endodontics, and is experienced in developing comprehensive treatment plans tailored to each patient’s needs. Dr. Downs is passionate about educating patients on preventive care to support long-term oral health and overall well-being. Dr. Downs earned her Doctor of Dental Surgery degree from the Indiana University School of Dentistry, following a Master of Science in Biomedical Science from Barry University and a Bachelor of Arts in Biology from Indiana University–Purdue University Indianapolis (IUPUI). During her academic career, she was recognized as a Delta Dental Scholarship recipient. With a strong clinical foundation and a commitment to patient education, Dr. Downs strives to help patients achieve and maintain healthy, confident smiles. Bradford Kess D.D.S, M.A., M.S., Orthodontist Bradford Kess D.D.S, M.A., M.S., Orthodontist ABOUT ME Dr. Kess says, “I love giving my patients great smiles! Nothing is more rewarding than taking a person who is embarrassed to smile and making it so they won’t stop smiling!” After graduating from The Ohio State University, Dr. Kess received his Dental Degree and his Orthodontics training from the Ohio State University College of Dentistry. To keep abreast of cutting edge technology, he’s a member of the American Association of Orthodontics. Dr. Kess says, “I am a second generation Orthodontist and I have been interested in being an Orthodontist my whole life!” Dr. Kess says, “I just moved to Arizona from Cleveland, Ohio, and I’m looking forward to not seeing snow anymore! I enjoy golf, jogging and spending time with my kids.” Education B.S., Food Technology–The Ohio State University M.A.., Education–The Ohio State University D.D.S.–The Ohio State University College of Dentistry M.S., Orthodontics–The Ohio State University College of Dentistry Affiliations Board Certified, American Association of Orthodontics What Our Patients Are Saying Dr. Tina was patient, kind, and thorough.
